format: Operator Program: traditional franchised Chick-fil-A Restaurant (free-standing, mall, in-line or drive-thru only unit); premises and equipment leased from Chick-fil-A

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a traditional franchised Chick-fil-A Restaurant business is from $317,521 to $3,463,155. This includes $10,000 that must be paid to the franchisor or any affiliate.

fee.quote: You must pay an initial franchise fee of $10,000 payable in full when you sign the Franchise Agreement whether for a traditional location or a captive venue unit.
fee.note: $5,000 of the $10,000 is held by Chick-fil-A as a working capital deposit, returned (less amounts owed) at termination or non-renewal; additional franchise fee of $5,000 for each additional Chick-fil-A Restaurant business, if offered. Item 7 Note 2: the fee is the only initial out-of-pocket investment the Operator is required to make.

royalty.basis: Gross Receipts (Base Operating Service Fee = 15% of Gross Receipts minus monthly equipment rental and business services fee), plus 50% of Net Profit as Additional Operating Service Fee
royalty.quote: "Base Operating Service Fee" for a particular restaurant for each calendar month is the amount by which 15% of the Gross Receipts for the month exceeds the monthly equipment rental payable and business services fee for the calendar month.

adFund.quote: Advertising fund contribution may vary (a) between 0% to 3.25%, to be determined by Chick-fil-A, as a percentage of "Gross Receipts" ... Since 6/30/89, Chick-fil-A has not charged any amount for advertising (0% of Gross Receipts) as a matter of internal policy, which is subject to change.
adFund.note: currently 0%, up to 3.25%; Operators in a geographic area may establish local or regional advertising fees (no % given)

otherRecurring.name: Equipment Rental
otherRecurring.amount: $750 to $5,000, monthly; current: Free-Standing and In-Line: $5,000/month; Drive-Through only: $4,000/month; Mall: $3,000/month

otherRecurring.name: Rent (Traditional Unit)
otherRecurring.amount: $3,500 to $100,655 (including, where applicable, percentage rent) per formula; Monthly

otherRecurring.name: Hardware and Software Support; High-Speed Internet Access

rentToFranchisor: Chick-fil-A (or a subsidiary) is the landlord or sublessor of traditional locations; rent $3,500 to $100,655 monthly (Item 6). For a site owned by Chick-fil-A there is no base rent and the Operator pays percentage rent: "Percentage of Gross Receipts Payable Above Breakpoint 6%" (breakpoint typically $0.00). Internal Rent Policy since January 1, 2015: rent (excluding equipment) "will not exceed 6% of the annual Gross Receipts" for traditional locations.

item19.quote: In 2025, of the approximately 2,302 domestic non-captive venue franchised Operator Chick-fil-A Restaurants located in non-malls (e.g., free-standing or drive-thru only units) that had been open and operated by Operators for at least one full calendar year as of December 31, 2025, the median annual sales volume was $9,087,673 and the average annual sales volume was $9,161,239
item19.note: Sales only: "The Financial Performance Representations do not reflect the costs of sales or operating expenses". Excludes company-operated restaurants, 25 captive venue units and 424 Licensed Units. 1,120 of the 2,302 (49%) did as well or better than the average.

special: Operator does not own the restaurant assets: premises leased from Chick-fil-A (rent up to 6% of Gross Receipts) and equipment rented ($750 to $5,000/month). Chick-fil-A takes a Base Operating Service Fee equal to 15% of Gross Receipts minus equipment rental and business services fee, plus an Additional Operating Service Fee of 50% of the restaurant's Net Profit; the Operator keeps a Base Profit of $1,000/month, Extra Profit advance up to $1,500/month, and the other 50% of Net Profit. Franchise agreement only with an individual. Opening inventory $22,950 to $107,000 bought partly from affiliate CFA Supply; distributor prices include amounts paid to Chick-fil-A for proprietary seasoning and coater.
issues: royalty is not a simple %: 15% of Gross Receipts includes equipment rental and business services fee, plus 50% profit share; Item 7 Additional Funds high printed '$3,463155' and equals the total high, cover/Item 7 total agree; Item 20 franchised 2025 start (2624) differs from 2024 end (2629); real estate not explicitly stated as excluded (premises leased from Chick-fil-A)
